question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

You should never visit her without her __consent__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consent"** means permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. (अनुमति)

 
 
• **Example: **She gave her consent to be part of the research study.
 
 
 
• **"Refusal" **refers to the act of declining or rejecting something. (अस्वीकृति)
 
 
• **Example: **His refusal to cooperate made the project more difficult.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the** opposite** of **'consent' **is **'refusal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Permission **(अनुमति): The act of allowing someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** You need **permission** from the principal to leave early.
 
 
 
• **Knowledge **(ज्ञान): Information and understanding about a subject.
 
 
• **Example: **Her **knowledge** of history is impressive.
 
 
 
• **Approval** (मंजूरी): The action of officially agreeing to something or accepting something as satisfactory.
 
 
• **Example:** The project received **approval** from the board.
